category_title: Students performing as docile, self-disciplined test-takers
minimal_context: Bill is preparing to take the SRI assessment in the classroom while the teacher gets ready to distribute the test booklets.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, it is time to get ready for the SRI assessment. Please find a seat so I can distribute the test booklets.

STUDENT: (Walking back from using the bathroom) Someone moved their table to my spot.

TUTOR: Just find another open table for now.

STUDENT: But that is my regular testing spot. I claimed it as my own.

TUTOR: Any seat will work for the test. Please sit down so we can begin.

STUDENT: Can I please sit at my regular spot? I need to pull the table close to my body and sit still there.

options.A: Ask the other student to switch seats with Bill, explaining that this is his 'lucky spot' for the assessment.
options.B: Guide Bill through short practices focusing on breath awareness, belly breathing, and awareness of his body and sounds.
options.C: Guide Bill through a 'bubble-blowing' technique where he visualizes his thoughts and releases them without judgment.
options.D: Use Quiet Time as a supportive strategy, having Bill withdraw from the classroom environment for a time-limited period.
